algorithm: The new policy adjusts several key aspects: 1) Increased base stock level (S_over_mean) to better handle high demand periods. 2) Reduced capacity ceiling (cap_over_mean) to avoid over-ordering. 3) Added responsiveness to last demand via blending factor. 4) Tuned forecast gain parameters to better track demand changes. 5) Increased inventory adjustment sensitivity (inventory_gain) to react faster to stock levels. The changes aim to reduce lost sales while controlling holding costs.
